1))) and "r12"."n" > 0 then "r12"."v" end) + (max(case when "r12"."rn" = ceil((1 + cast($2 as decimal(38, 10)) * ("r12"."n" - 1))) and "r12"."n" > 0 then "r12"."v" end) - max(case when "r12"."rn" = floor((1 + cast($3 as decimal(38, 10)) * ("r12"."n" - 1))) and "r12"."n" > 0 then "r12"."v" end)) * max((1 + cast($4 as decimal(38, 10)) * ("r12"."n" - 1)) - floor((1 + cast($5 as decimal(38, 10)) * ("r12"."n" - 1))))) as decimal(38, 10)) as "c1" from (select "r1"."c0" as "c0", cast("r1"."c1" as decimal(38, 10)) as v, row_number() over (partition by "r1"."c0" order by case when cast("r1"."c1" as decimal(38, 10)) is null then 1 else 0 end, cast("r1"."c1" as decimal(38, 10))) as rn, count(cast("r1"."c1" as decimal(38, 10))) over (partition by "r1"."c0") as n from (select "r2"."c2" as "c0", "r2"."c4" as "c1" from (select "r3"."c0" as "c0", "r3"."c1" as "c1", "r3"."c2" as "c2", "r11"."c0" as "c3", "r11"."c1" as "c4", "r11"."c2" as "c5" from (select "customers"."customer_id" as "c0", "customers"."city" as "c1", "customers"."country" as "c2" from "customers") as "r3" inner join (select "r5"."c2" as "c0", cast(coalesce("r5"."c7", cast($6 as integer)) as decimal(38, 10)) as "c1", cast(coalesce("r5"."c5", cast($7 as integer)) as decimal(38, 10)) as "c2" from (select "r6"."c0" as "c0", "r6"."c1" as "c1", "r6"."c2" as "c2", "r6"."c3" as "c3", "r6"."c4" as "c4", "r6"."c5" as "c5", "r10"."c0" as "c6", "r10"."c1" as "c7" from (select "orders"."order_id" as "c0", "orders"."order_date" as "c1", "orders"."customer_id" as "c2", "orders"."employee_id" as "c3", "orders"."shipped_date" as "c4", cast("orders"."freight" as decimal(38, 10)) as "c5" from "orders") as "r6" left join (select "r8"."c0" as "c0", cast(sum(cast(cast((cast(cast((cast("r8"."c1" as decimal(38, 10)) * cast("r8"."c2" as decimal(38, 10))) as decimal(38, 10)) as decimal(38, 10)) * cast(cast((cast(cast($8 as integer) as decimal(38, 10)) - cast("r8"."c3" as decimal(38, 10))) as decimal(38, 10)) as decimal(38, 10))) as decimal(38, 10)) as decimal(38, 10))) as decimal(38, 10)) as "c1" from (select "order_details"."order_id" as "c0", cast("order_details"."unit_price" as decimal(38, 10)) as "c1", "order_details"."quantity" as "c2", cast("order_details"."discount" as decimal(38, 10)) as "c3" from "order_details") as "r8" group by "r8"."c0") as "r10" on ("r6"."c0" = "r10"."c0")) as "r5") as "r11" on ("r3"."c0" = "r11"."c0")) as "r2") as "r1") as "r12" group by "r12"."c0") as "r13" order by case when "r13"."c0" is null then 1 else 0 end asc, "r13"."c0" asc

observations.name: Window top N
observations.sql: select "r5"."c0" as "customer_id", "r5"."c1" as "order_id", "r5"."c2" as "order_date", cast("r5"."c3" as text) as "position" from (select "r1"."c0" as "c0", "r1"."c1" as "c1", "r1"."c2" as "c2", "r1"."c3" as "c3" from (select "r2"."c0" as "c0", "r2"."c1" as "c1", "r2"."c2" as "c2", row_number() over (partition by "r2"."c0" order by case when "r2"."c2" is null then 1 else 0 end asc, "r2"."c2" desc, case when "r2"."c1" is null then 1 else 0 end asc, "r2"."c1" desc) as "c3" from (select "r3"."c2" as "c0", "r3"."c0" as "c1", "r3"."c1" as "c2" from (select "orders"."order_id" as "c0", "orders"."order_date" as "c1", "orders"."customer_id" as "c2", "orders"."employee_id" as "c3", "orders"."shipped_date" as "c4", cast("orders"."freight" as decimal(38, 10)) as "c5" from "orders") as "r3") as "r2") as "r1" where ("r1"."c3" <= cast($1 as integer))) as "r5" order by case when "r5"."c0" is null then 1 else 0 end asc, "r5"."c0" asc, case when "r5"."c3" is null then 1 else 0 end asc, "r5"."c3" asc
